handoffs.message: Drafted trajectory and preference store contract plus machine-readable trader feedback and execution telemetry schemas with registry linkage fields. Ready for governance review.

APPROVED for v1 lock. Review at services/feedback/schema/review_fb001_fb002_claude.md. governance boundary correct (feedback cannot trigger live promotion), event family separation clean, linkage object sufficient for REG-001/EV-001. Three minor items: (M-1) actor_role 'reviewer' not in OC-001 role enum — reconcile in FB-002 follow-up; (M-2) telemetry promotion_state omits 'draft' — add comment to contract §6; (M-3) 'annotate' operation in edits is non-standard — add $comment to schema. Recommend evaluating registry_id as required field when EV-001 lands.
